x-run-quality.scope: 管理员对一次运行做第三方质检：有界证据包 + 结构化质检意见 + 直连 Hermes 评审

access.userEntry: 不出现在用户专用入口白名单；普通用户读取自己的运行仍用 get_own_run/get_own_step_result
access.note: 质检意见是管理员侧的运维产物，不是用户反馈；用户问题仍走 submit_system_feedback

auditPacket.bound: 每条提示词/回复按 promptLimit 截断（默认2000、最大8000码点），整包内联提示词字节有硬预算；超出部分显式标记 promptOmitted 并给出 promptPage 续读坐标
auditPacket.itemSample: for_each 步骤只内联前 itemSample 项（默认2、最大10）的提示词与回复；其余项用 get_step_result 的 itemIndex 分页读取
auditPacket.values: 输入值经 scrubBusinessValue 去本机路径后内联，受字节预算约束；步骤输出与最终输出只给元数据，值用 get_step_result/get_run_outputs 读
auditPacket.noPaths: 不返回本机路径、运行归档目录、绑定配置或能力内部实现，只返回可解释业务结果所需字段

critique.idempotency: critiqueId 由客户端预生成；重复 ID 返回 409 RUN_CRITIQUE_ALREADY_EXISTS，不是幂等成功
critique.revision: 更新状态必须带当前 revision；409 RUN_CRITIQUE_REVISION_CONFLICT 后重读，不盲重试
critique.writeScope: submit_run_critique 只接受 source=manual|agent；source=hermes 只能由 audit_run_with_hermes 写入

hermesAudit.paid: 会真实调用管理员已启用的 Hermes Profile 一次（可能计费），不自动重试
hermesAudit.output: 固定输出契约 verdict/score/summary/findings/recommendations；JSON 不可严格解析或字段不符时保持失败且不写入质检记录
hermesAudit.recovery: 响应丢失用同一 critiqueId 调 get_run_critique 对账；记录不存在时由操作者显式决定是否重跑（会再次计费）

x-step-agent-feedback.scope: 管理员把一个已完成步骤的反馈连同执行期上下文交给该步骤原本调用的 Agent 一次，拿回修订结果作为参考

access.userEntry: 不出现在用户专用入口白名单；普通用户只能走系统反馈或本人审核
access.note: 它不是运行、不是重做、不是质检意见：不写运行记录、不改场景、不发布、不生成媒体

context.source: 按运行快照重建：解析后的步骤输入、上游步骤结果、for_each 逐项来源项与 iteration.item、被修订的原结果、该步骤当时的 hermesProfile/hermesProvider/hermesModel
context.prompt: 模板渲染、输出契约与附件构造复用执行期同一路径；反馈作为附录注入，不改模板与快照
context.omitted: 响应不返回完整提示词（含本机归档媒体路径）；媒体端口只回固定引用与数量

boundaries.noRedo: 不排队、不新建运行、不写运行记录（含 feedbackHistory）、不改状态或 revision；要采纳修订必须显式走 review_run redo 或 preview_rerun/rerun 的 changes.feedback
boundaries.validation: 与反馈重做链路共用同一份反馈校验与长度上限：目标必须是运行快照里真实存在的 Hermes 步骤，接受/拒绝口径一致
boundaries.cost: 真实调用模型、可能计费、一次请求不自动重试；解析或输出校验失败返回 502 并带一段有界原文（不写入任何记录）
boundaries.reconciliation: 本操作没有可对账的持久记录：回执丢失时读运行记录可确认「什么都没发生」，是否重发（会再次计费）由操作者决定

x-comfy-static-switch.behavior: After runtime bindings, remove only the unselected optional input of a proven-static built-in lazy switch. Retain every node, selected input, output ID and other consumer. Unknown or cyclic selectors stay unchanged.
x-comfy-static-switch.emptyOptionalVideo: An explicitly bound empty optional video clears the file input; never silently falls back to the workflow's sample video. A reachable required loader still fails provider validation.
x-comfy-static-switch.sideEffects: No node execution, model call, workflow-file mutation, draft write or publication. Applies to both UI-converted and API-format execution graphs; inspection remains the original graph.

scheduling.omittedFields: default to serial/stop when carry enabled

references.iteration.previous: selected output of immediate predecessor; typed as declared output; initialSourceRef or null on first item
references.iteration.hasPrevious: boolean; true for explicit valid seed or successful predecessor

x-for-each-carry.state: non-null declared value; media must be non-empty readable flat list; false, 0 and empty text are valid
x-for-each-carry.resume: reuse only contiguous completed prefix with matching source values and valid carry output; first gap/change invalidates suffix
x-for-each-carry.rerun: item edits/feedback/rerun invalidate selected item and suffix; replacing an item preserves replacement and invalidates suffix; downstream dependencies rerun; one replacement per chain per request
x-for-each-carry.results: ordinary output aggregation unchanged; item inputs/outputs use existing checkpoints and paginated result APIs; no separate state store

errors.configuration: INVALID_AI_REQUEST for HTTP request schema errors; INVALID_WORKFLOW for semantic configuration errors
errors.execution: failed item/step with error; no later item scheduled

x-for-each-carry.sideEffects: draft configuration is not publication or execution; normal execution/resume/rerun may incur provider costs; lost receipt reconciles pre-saved ID

x-for-each-item-retry.default: 0 retries; omitting both fields keeps the historical single-attempt behavior
x-for-each-item-retry.accounting: each retry appends one item warning with the attempt number, the reason and the wait; the wait is abortable
x-for-each-item-retry.exhausted: the last failure takes the unchanged onError/carry failure path
x-for-each-item-retry.cost: a retry re-invokes the model and may be billed again; the default is 0 for that reason
x-for-each-item-retry.references: retries happen inside one item; item order, reviewAfterItems barrier and carry prefix reuse are unchanged

managementIngress.warning: a LAN-reachable management port exposes the full management surface; firewall it to the intended subnet

API_HOST.description: 管理入口监听地址；生产缺省0.0.0.0，正式部署建议显式设置。改为非回环会公开完整管理面，须自行用防火墙限制来源

ZANE_ALLOW_LAN_INGRESS.description: 显式允许在开启用户专用入口(ZANE_PUBLIC_USER_PORT)的同时把管理入口绑定到非回环地址；缺省false时启动直接失败。只影响监听绑定，不放宽路径白名单、角色校验或loopback-only初始化

ZANE_PUBLIC_USER_PORT.description: 留空不开启；0仅隔离测试使用；不得与非零API_PORT相同

ZANE_PUBLIC_USER_HOST.description: 用户入口监听地址；设为0.0.0.0可在局域网直接访问用户入口，不需要ZANE_ALLOW_LAN_INGRESS（该开关只管管理入口）

url.addressPolicy: public addresses only; loopback, private, link-local and reserved literals or DNS results are rejected
url.plaintextHttp: allowed but sends credentials unencrypted; prefer HTTPS when available

items.fieldName: multipart file field; repeated in source order

multipartImages.localFiles: authorized current-run media only: this run's archived private copies, or a ComfyUI attachment belonging to this run (uploaded input or upstream output in the same run) read from the configured ComfyUI view route; no arbitrary path, other run's file or URL/preview fallback

localRootFiles.source: a real file inside the admin-configured local-export setting root (the same single boundary used by core.code localExport/fileAccess)
localRootFiles.containment: real paths are resolved and compared, so .. escapes are rejected rather than normalized away and a symlink resolving outside the root is refused; the root path itself is never returned
localRootFiles.disabled: without a configured root this source is unavailable and the step fails HTTP_REQUEST_MEDIA_UNSUPPORTED
localRootFiles.scope: only meaningful with bodyFormat=multipart and a declared multipartImages mapping

multipartImages.comfyAttachmentPolicy: only ordinary filename/subfolder segments are accepted, so a crafted name cannot point the request outside the ComfyUI media directory

fields.path: JSON path to array; default data

responseImages.output: images:image_list; validated local PNG/JPEG/WebP; base64 replaced with explicit omission marker

retries.description: additional attempts after the first failure; omitted or 0 keeps exactly one request

retryDelaySeconds.description: base delay before each retry; exponential backoff doubling per retry and capped at 60 seconds

outputs.response: optional declared output; JSON value, or UTF-8 text for non-JSON; null for empty; mapped base64 explicitly omitted
outputs.status: optional declared output; HTTP status number
outputs.images: optional image_list when responseImages configured; declare it alone for image-only scenes

deterministicFailureExcerpt.trigger: non-2xx status that is not retryable
deterministicFailureExcerpt.location: step or item warnings, prefixed 第三方接口返回HTTP <status>的上游响应：
deterministicFailureExcerpt.redaction: redactErrorText applied before storage: credentials, tokens and URLs are masked
deterministicFailureExcerpt.truncation: explicit …（已截断） suffix; never silently dropped
deterministicFailureExcerpt.emptyBody: no warning is fabricated when the upstream body is empty
deterministicFailureExcerpt.unchanged: error message, error code and details.status keep their existing contract; the excerpt is advisory only

sideEffects.execute: one request per attempt; may incur third-party cost or mutate third-party state
sideEffects.automaticRetries: opt-in through retries; resends the identical request only after network failures, timeouts or HTTP 408/429/500/502/503/504/524, so a lost acknowledgement can repeat third-party billing or state changes
sideEffects.edgeTimeoutStatus: 524 means an edge proxy gave up waiting for the origin; the origin may still be producing the result, so a resend can duplicate the generation or its billing

x-code-step.entry: async function body evaluated once; return an object keyed by the declared output ports

sandbox.isolation: worker_thread + node:vm over a contextified null-prototype global; one single-use worker per execution; string code generation disabled inside the context
sandbox.sharedGlobals: none; only ECMAScript built-ins and a console defined inside the sandbox realm
sandbox.webAssembly: engine-level only; bounded by timeout and memory
sandbox.mediatedFileAccess: filesystem:false stays literal: the sandbox holds no fs capability. Optional read-only directory listing and metadata are host-mediated data requests (see fileAccess), and optional local export is a host-side write of a plan; neither hands a host object to user code

code.inputAccess: inputs keyed by the declared input port keys; media inputs enter as a read-only [{filename}] projection with no path, URL or bytes
code.output: must return an object containing every declared output port with the declared type; extra keys are rejected

mediaOutputs.value: ordered array of file names (strings) or {filename} objects; duplicates are allowed and order is preserved
mediaOutputs.scope: only media already present on this step's declared input ports, resolved to the same archived items of the current run; the sandbox never creates, moves, renames or exposes media bytes, paths or URLs
mediaOutputs.mismatch: an unknown file name or a media kind that does not match the declared port is INVALID_CODE_OUTPUT

x-code-step.determinism: pure data transformation expected; Date/Math.random are available but recorded results stay the authority

localExport.enable: capabilityConfig.localExport = { enabled: true, planKey?: string, onConflict?: overwrite|skip|fail }
localExport.mediated: the sandbox still has no filesystem access: user code returns a { items: [{ source, target }] } plan, and the host performs every write after the step
localExport.root: only inside the admin-configured local-export setting root; unset root makes the step fail with LOCAL_EXPORT_DISABLED
localExport.containment: each target is resolved and must stay inside the root, otherwise LOCAL_EXPORT_OUTSIDE_ROOT; .. escapes are rejected, not normalized away
localExport.target: absolute path or path relative to the root; must end with a supported media extension
localExport.source: a media file name that exists on this step's declared input ports; bytes come from this run's or an authorized source run's archive, and for media generated earlier in the same run that is not archived yet (archiving happens at the end of the workflow) the host fetches it from the configured comfyuiBaseUrl. Arbitrary external URLs and other unarchived media still fail
localExport.onConflict: overwrite (default, atomic temp file + rename), skip (keep existing bytes) or fail
localExport.output: when the step declares a local_export output port, the written/skipped items are recorded there

fileAccess.mediated: the sandbox still has no filesystem access of its own: it gets a read-only zane.fs facade whose list/stat/readText calls are answered by the host outside the sandbox; no host function object ever enters the sandbox realm
fileAccess.root: the same admin-configured local-export setting root; unset root makes a file call fail with FILE_ACCESS_DISABLED
fileAccess.containment: each requested path is resolved and must stay inside the root, otherwise FILE_OUTSIDE_ROOT; .. escapes are rejected, not normalized away
fileAccess.symlinks: an existing path whose real path leaves the root is rejected, so symlinks cannot read outside the authorized directory
fileAccess.api: globalThis.zane.fs.list(path) -> [{ name, path, isFile, isDir, isSymbolicLink, size }] sorted by name; zane.fs.stat(path) -> { path, exists, isFile, isDir, isSymbolicLink, size } with exists:false instead of throwing when missing; zane.fs.readText(path) -> the file's UTF-8 text (for picking one line out of an action/prompt list), FILE_NOT_FOUND when missing and FILE_TOO_LARGE above the byte cap
fileAccess.returnedPaths: paths returned by list/stat are absolute paths inside the root, so existing files there can be handed to downstream steps (for example a ComfyUI upload); they never expose anything outside the root
fileAccess.readOnly: no write, create, delete or rename; directory listings, metadata, and explicitly requested text via readText (never executed or parsed, never written back)
fileAccess.limits: at most 500 directory entries per list call, otherwise FILE_LIST_TOO_LARGE; at most 1 MB per readText call, otherwise FILE_TOO_LARGE; paths at most 1024 characters

sideEffects.execute: local CPU and memory only; no external service, no provider cost; with localExport enabled the host also copies declared input media into the admin-authorized root directory, and with fileAccess enabled it reads directory listings, metadata and explicitly requested text inside that same root

x-local-export.scope: core.code 步骤的可选本地导出

config.enabled: boolean; 省略或 false 时不写任何文件
config.planKey: 本步骤已声明的 json/text 输出端口名，其值即导出计划
config.onConflict: overwrite|skip|fail；目标已存在时的行为，默认 overwrite（重跑同一场景得到最新结果）

plan.format: zane-local-export-plan/v1（可选，仅作标记，不参与校验）
plan.items: 数组，最多 144 项；每项 {source, target}
plan.source: 本步骤声明输入端口里的媒体文件名（不含路径分隔符）；沙箱只能看到 filename，看不到路径/URL/字节
plan.target: 目标文件路径；绝对路径或以根目录为基准的相对路径，必须落在配置根目录之内

root.setting: 系统单例设置 local-export（管理员经 HTTP/MCP 配置）；未配置时整个特性不生效
root.containment: 对根目录与目标都取真实路径后比较，越界即 LOCAL_EXPORT_OUTSIDE_ROOT，不接受 .. 逃逸
root.symlinks: 目标路径上已存在的任何一段是符号链接即拒绝，避免写到根目录之外

sideEffects.execute: 仅在运行实际执行该步骤时向本机受控目录写入媒体副本；不调用模型、不计费、不改写归档媒体
sideEffects.idempotency: 按 onConflict 决定覆盖或跳过；写入使用临时文件加原子改名，失败不会留下半截文件

x-local-file-access.scope: core.code 步骤的可选受控本地文件读取
x-local-file-access.enable: capabilityConfig.fileAccess = { enabled: true }；省略或 false 时沙箱里没有 zane.fs，任何文件请求都不存在

root.setting: 与本地导出共用系统单例设置 local-export（管理员经 HTTP/MCP 配置）；未配置时整步失败 FILE_ACCESS_DISABLED
root.containment: 每次请求都对根目录与目标取真实路径后比较，越界即 FILE_OUTSIDE_ROOT；.. 逃逸被拒绝而不是被中和
root.symlinks: 目标真实路径经符号链接/联接点指向根目录之外时拒绝（不读取根外内容）
root.shared: 读与写共用同一个根目录，读写各自需要步骤级开关；开启读取不会获得任何写权限，反之亦然

api.surface: 沙箱内只在开启时注入 globalThis.zane.fs，且只有三个只读方法，都是数据请求、不是宿主函数引用
api.list: zane.fs.list(path) → [{ name, path, isFile, isDir, isSymbolicLink, size }]，按名称排序；目录项自身是符号链接时只标记不跟随
api.stat: zane.fs.stat(path) → { path, exists, isFile, isDir, isSymbolicLink, size }；目标不存在返回 exists:false 而不是抛错
api.readText: zane.fs.readText(path) → string，按 UTF-8 读取文件文本（用于从动作/提示词等多行文本里挑一行）；目标不存在报 FILE_NOT_FOUND，超过 1024 KB 报 FILE_TOO_LARGE；只返回文本内容，不执行、不解析，也不写回
api.path: 返回的 path 是受控根目录内的绝对路径，便于把根内既有文件交给下游步骤（例如 ComfyUI 上传）；越界请求仍然失败
api.sync: 三个方法都是同步返回值（也可 await）；沙箱内没有定时器，宿主在沙箱之外串行应答每个请求

sideEffects.execute: 只读取受控根目录内既有文件的元数据（名称/类型/大小）与显式请求的文本内容，不写文件、不改内容、不调用模型、不计费

x-local-media.scope: 查看运行结果里已记录的本机媒体文件（core.code fileAccess 产出的路径）

access.userEntry: 不出现在用户专用入口；普通用户的运行结果不通过此通道读取本机文件
access.note: 这不是任意文件读取代理：客户端不能指定路径，只能指定输出坐标，路径由服务端从运行记录重新解析

parameters.stepId: 定位步骤；省略时读取最终输出
parameters.itemIndex: for_each 的逐项序号；省略时读取整步输出
parameters.mediaIndex: 该输出内第几个本地媒体路径（按 collectLocalMediaPaths 的首次出现顺序，0 基，默认 0）
parameters.w: 可选显示宽度（16–2048）：图片返回 WebP 派生图，非图片或缩放失败回退原字节；省略为原文件

route.resolution: 服务端按 (stepId,itemIndex,outputKey) 取出运行记录中的值，再用 collectLocalMediaPaths 取第 mediaIndex 项

root.setting: 管理员配置的本地导出根目录（系统单例 local-export，与 core.code localExport/fileAccess 共用）
root.containment: 路径归一化后必须位于根目录内部，越界即 FILE_OUTSIDE_ROOT；.. 逃逸被拒绝而不是被中和
root.symlinks: 目标真实路径经符号链接/联接点指向根目录之外时拒绝（不读取根外内容）
root.disabled: 未配置根目录（root 为空）时报 FILE_ACCESS_DISABLED，不做任何文件系统读取

sideEffects.read: 只读取根目录内既有文件；不写文件、不生成媒体、不调用模型、不计费（可选缩放派生图写入项目预览缓存）

x-notification-webhook.scope: 系统单例设置 notification-webhook；仅管理员，普通用户入口不提供

events.filtering: 只转发已保存 events 里的事件；run.checkpoint、step.started、step.item.* 与内部事件永不转发
events.ordering: 按产生顺序入队；给出 events 时按固定白名单顺序去重保存

aggregate.window: aggregateSeconds 5–300（默认 30）；窗口内事件合并为一条消息
aggregate.perFormat: 实际上限 = min(全局上限, 平台上限)：discord 1900、slack 2900、feishu 3500、generic 1900
aggregate.truncation: 正文超限时明确追加 …（已截断），不静默丢弃
aggregate.pendingOverflow: 超出上限丢弃最旧事件并计入 delivery.droppedEvents

adapters.layer: 聚合层只产出统一文本与事件数组；平台差异（载荷结构、提及策略、正文上限）集中在 domain/notificationFormats.ts
adapters.slack: {text, unfurl_links:false, unfurl_media:false}；Slack Incoming Webhook 形状
adapters.feishu: {msg_type:"text", content:{text}}；飞书/Lark 自定义机器人形状
adapters.generic: {source:"zane-workbench", text, events: NotificationEvent[]}；自建接收端可拿结构化事件

delivery.mode: 旁路：observe 同步入队且无 I/O，发送异步；不影响运行、审核、结算与归档
delivery.retries: 单条消息最多 2 次尝试；仅网络失败、超时、429 与 5xx 重试，其它 4xx 不重试
delivery.rateLimit: 429 时按 Retry-After 头（秒）或响应体 retry_after（秒，可为小数）退避，上限 5 秒
delivery.failure: 失败批不重排队；本轮剩余事件丢弃并计入 failedMessages/droppedEvents，lastError 记录脱敏摘要
delivery.durability: 内存队列；进程重启后未发送事件丢失，不落库、不建旁路数据库
delivery.shutdown: 停机时最多等待 3 秒做一次尽力投递

security.urlStorage: 明文存本机 SQLite（产品明确选择）
security.urlRead: 读接口只返回 urlMasked：保留协议与主机，路径末段与查询值只留末4位
security.urlWrite: 三态：省略=保持、空串=清除、非空=替换；启用要求已有地址且至少 1 个事件
security.redaction: 出站正文对运行错误做 redactErrorText；日志里的 url 同为掩码
security.externalReach: 只有 test_notification_webhook 立即出网；保存/启用/读取都不发送

sideEffects.update: 只改配置；不发送、不调用模型、不计费
sideEffects.test: 向已保存地址真实发送一条固定测试消息；一次请求，不改变配置

mode.enabled: worker sends the selected registry provider directly and never reads a Hermes Profile, a Hermes gateway URL or a Hermes API key
mode.disabled: unchanged pre-1.5.39 behavior: the same Hermes Profile fields, the same hermesProvider/hermesModel overrides, /v1/runs with the /v1/chat/completions fallback, the same messages

migration.from: 1.5.39 x-direct-llm v1 system singleton (GET/PATCH /api/v1/settings/direct-llm, MCP get_direct_llm/update_direct_llm, fixed document id direct-llm, fields enabled/baseUrl/apiKeyEnv/model)
migration.to: per-provider records in the @zane-system settings collection, document id <direct-llm-provider:><providerId>, each revision-protected; list/get/create/update/delete plus a model query operation
migration.singletonRemoved: the v1 singleton operations no longer exist. No published snapshot is rewritten and no historical run is changed.
migration.legacyResolution: a step with capabilityConfig.direct=true and no capabilityConfig.providerId keeps working: it resolves the reserved provider id direct-llm-default, whose value is, in order, the new-style stored default provider, the still-present 1.5.39 singleton document (projected onto protocol openai-chat with models:[model]), then the environment defaults ZANE_DIRECT_LLM_BASE_URL/ZANE_DIRECT_LLM_API_KEY_ENV/ZANE_DIRECT_LLM_MODEL
migration.legacyRevision: the legacy singleton and the environment defaults have no new-style revision yet, so they read as revision 0; the first successful save of that provider writes a new-style document and returns revision 1, and the legacy singleton document is removed in the same write
migration.migrateBySelection: select a provider in the step (capabilityConfig.providerId) to leave the reserved default behind; nothing is migrated automatically

providers.storage: authoritative SQLite production_documents, one revision-protected document per provider; never browser storage and never a scenario definition

providerId.description: stable client-chosen UUID or slug; part of the document id and never rewritten

name.description: display name only; it is not an identity

baseUrl.addressPolicy: loopback and private addresses are allowed on purpose: the provider is usually a local gateway or proxy; this is a deliberate exception to the core.http_request public-address-only rule

apiKey.storage: plaintext in the local SQLite direct-llm-provider record
apiKey.note: user explicitly chose plaintext-at-rest. It is never returned by any read operation (only apiKeyMasked/lastFour), never logged, never written to a run record, run input archive, published snapshot or export manifest, and never included in an error message

writeSemantics.omitted: keep the stored key unchanged (editing only the name or address never clears it)

apiKeyEnv.note: compatibility fallback only: used when apiKey is empty. Only the variable name is stored and returned; the value is read from the workbench process environment
apiKeyEnv.precedence: apiKey (plaintext, saved) wins; otherwise apiKeyEnv is read from process.env at request time

credential.description: read-only projection that tells the caller whether a key is usable and where it comes from, without ever exposing the plaintext

models.description: cached upstream list merged with hand-typed entries; order preserved, deduplicated, hand-typed entries never dropped

modelsFetchedAt.description: last successful upstream model query; null means never queried

revision.description: 0 for a provider that only exists as the legacy singleton or as environment defaults

plaintextAtRest.fact: the API key is stored in plaintext in this machine's SQLite database (production_documents, collection settings, document direct-llm-provider:<providerId>)
plaintextAtRest.rationale: the user explicitly chose plaintext-at-rest after being shown the alternatives (separate file, master-key encryption, plaintext)
plaintextAtRest.operatorDuty: protect the data directory, its backups, database copies and any file-level snapshot; anyone who can read that file can read the key
guards: no read operation returns the plaintext; only apiKeyMasked (last four) and credential.configured
logs and the structured log buffer redact apiKey/secret fields (observability/logRedaction) and direct-llm log entries carry no key material
run records, run inputs (inputs/input.json), runtime.json, step results, agent prompts and error messages never contain the key
published scene snapshots store only the step capabilityConfig (providerId/model), so the key never enters a snapshot
the key is not part of any export manifest or media archive produced by this workbench

providers.modelResolution: capabilityConfig.model wins; otherwise the provider's first models entry; a provider with no models and no step model fails before any request with 直连模型提供商未配置模型名

body.system: every system message concatenated with a blank line, sent as a top-level field and never as a messages entry

anthropic.response: concatenation of every content[] block with type:'text'
anthropic.images: {type:'image', source:{type:'base64', media_type:'<media_type>', data:'<base64>'}}; an http(s) image URL becomes {type:'url', url:<url>}
anthropic.modelsParsing: data[].id (the same envelope the Anthropic models endpoint returns)
anthropic.modelsUnsupported: HTTP 404/405 or an envelope without a recognizable data[].id list fails with 该协议不支持列模型; it is never reported as an empty list

modelCatalog.authentication: the same protocol headers as the completion request, so the same key resolution applies (stored plaintext apiKey first, apiKeyEnv fallback otherwise)
modelCatalog.caching: a successful query merges the upstream list with the existing models array (upstream order first, deduplicated) and writes modelsFetchedAt to the same revision-protected provider document; hand-typed entries are never dropped
modelCatalog.failure: any failure (unsupported endpoint, non-2xx, unrecognized envelope, bad credentials, network error) is reported with the upstream status and a redacted message summary; a failure never writes an empty list, never clears modelsFetchedAt and is never retried automatically
modelCatalog.sideEffect: one upstream GET request and, only on success, one revision-protected cache write; no model is called and no generation cost is incurred

request.timeout: settings.workflowTimeoutMinutes, the same per-step budget as core.hermes; the model query uses it too
request.cancellation: the run AbortSignal aborts the completion; the model query is admin-triggered and has no run signal
request.retries: none: one request per call, because a chat completion is not idempotent and a resend could be billed twice
request.credentialResolution: provider.apiKey (stored plaintext) when non-empty, otherwise process.env[provider.apiKeyEnv]; the resolved value only ever reaches the authentication header and the upstream-echo scrubber, never a log, error message, run record or response

x-direct-llm.multimodal: declared image_list/video_list inputs reuse the exact core.hermes attachment path (frame extraction, compression, base64 data URL, 10 MB inline budget, compression cache); only the per-protocol image mapping differs, and an already-encoded data URL is re-split instead of re-encoded
failureMessages: 直连模型提供商未启用
直连模型提供商未配置服务地址
直连模型提供商未配置 API 密钥
直连模型提供商未配置模型名
直连模型提供商环境变量的值格式无效
直连模型提供商认证失败
直连模型提供商请求失败
直连模型提供商请求超时
直连模型提供商网络连接失败
直连模型提供商没有返回文本内容
直连模型提供商不存在

sideEffects.queryModels: one upstream GET /models request and, on success only, one revision-protected cache write; no model call, no generation, no cost
sideEffects.execute: one provider request per step; may incur provider cost, never retried automatically; no Hermes gateway, Hermes Profile or Hermes credential is read

x-credits.unit: credits（服务定价单位，不是上游成本镜像：上游不回传 token 账单与 GPU 秒数）
x-credits.precision: 金额最多两位小数；内部一律用「厘」整数（1 分 = 100 厘）做加减乘，只在接口与界面边界换算成分。单价、基础分、面值与调账数量超出两位小数在写入前被拒绝，不静默截断；余额、流水、预扣、结算与对账合计都不带浮点尾数。
x-credits.pricingSource: 场景草稿 scene.pricing → 发布快照固化 → 运行提交时随 credit.pricing 固化
x-credits.billableSteps: hermes / comfyui（不含纯拼接 media.video_concat）/ core.http_request / core.llm；给本地步骤定价在发布校验被拒绝

units.per_item: 按成功项计；逐项来源为前序步骤输出时必须声明 maxItems 作为预估上限

timing.reserve: submit 按上限价预扣，幂等键 run_reserve:<runId>；余额不足 402 CREDIT_INSUFFICIENT 且不进入队列；提交被拒绝时全额释放
timing.settle: 运行到终态按实际成功产出结算，幂等键 run_settle:<runId>；差额按该运行自己的预扣金额退还（release 也走同一入口，全额退）
timing.packageSettle: 包运行终态按已完成项的上限价结算，其余退还；幂等键 run_settle:<packageRunId>；charged ≤ 包预扣价
timing.review: waiting 不是终态、不结算；approve/redo 不二次收费（同一份预扣内）
timing.resumeOrRerun: 新建运行并按来源运行固化的 pricing 重新预扣；复用步骤与逐项不重复计费（reusedFromRunId）

charged.included: completed 的步骤（per_call）与 completed 的逐项（per_item）
charged.excluded: failed / skipped / cancelled / 复用项 / 缺失步骤
charged.cap: charged ≤ 预扣价；永不事后补扣

ledger.appendOnly: credit_entries；余额 credit_accounts 是它的物化值，同一事务更新
ledger.available: available = balance − reserved；reserved 是进行中运行的未结算预扣

redeem.plaintext: 明文写入本机 SQLite，管理员可随时经 list_redeem_codes 回读；哈希与末四位继续保留，兑换校验走 sha256
redeem.idempotent: 同码重复提交返回 alreadyRedeemed，不重复加分
redeem.enumeration: 他人已用 / 不存在 / 已作废统一返回 REDEEM_CODE_INVALID
redeem.void: 单向幂等。未使用的码直接作废；已兑换的码也可作废（退款场景）：默认 reclaim=true 时按面值从兑换人账户收回，写一条 cdk_refund 负向流水（幂等键 cdk_refund:<codeId>）。余额不足不拒绝作废：扣到余额为 0 为止，未收回的差额在 shortfall 里如实返回（永不产生负余额，也不要求先充值）。reclaim=false 只作废不退分。作废后该码按不存在处理，不能再次兑换
redeem.voidBatch: 默认 includeRedeemed=true：未使用的全部作废，已兑换的逐张按 reclaim 收回，同样扣到余额为 0 为止；缺口合计在 shortfall、逐张缺口在 partial 里列出，不中断其余张。includeRedeemed=false 保留旧行为，只作废未使用的

quota.perUser: ZANE_MAX_ACTIVE_RUNS_PER_USER（默认 0=不限制；排队+执行+等待审核都占用），超出 429 USER_RUN_LIMIT_REACHED

outOfScope: 历史运行（无定价记录，不补扣）
积分表不进发布快照（快照只固化 pricing 规则）

x-packages.unit: 场景包（package）= 用户面产品单元；场景是包内部件，用户面不出现「场景」

structure.draft: 包级输入 inputs + 有序组件项 items；每项固定 sceneId+versionId 并声明输入绑定

binding.previous: 取前序项产出（sourceRef=<项ID>.<输出键>，selection all/item）

validation: 组件必填输入必须被绑定或被默认值覆盖

publish.selfContained: 发布时把组件发布版内嵌成快照（scene/workflow/optionPresets）；组件之后改版或删除不影响已发布的包
publish.idempotent: publicationId 即包版本ID；同一ID重复调用返回既有版本，不重复发布
publish.effect: 只固化快照与定价，不执行生成

run.model: 父协调器 + N 个普通子运行；复用现有队列/审核/续跑/归档/媒体权限，不新建状态机
run.funding: submit 一次预扣全部上限价（包级资金）；子运行不各自扣费；按已完成项结算并退还差额，永不补扣
run.serial: 逐项串行；失败、取消或确认点即停
run.confirmAfter: 项完成后包运行与该顸都进入 waiting_confirm；approve 继续剩余项、redo 重跑本项；已确认前段不重复生成

access.rule: 组件场景不需要单独授权；只有组件场景授权而无包授权不能提交包
access.notFound: 非本人包运行一律 404，避免探测

presentation.purpose: 发布快照里的服务呈现层，决定用户打开这个包时看到的页面；不改执行、不影响定价
presentation.page: 有序区块数组，每个包可以完全不同：hero/features/gallery/steps/text/form/results/faq/cta。form 最多 1 个，未知 type 在发布时拒绝
presentation.fallback: 省略 page 时按 hero+highlights 合成默认页，旧包无需改配置
presentation.theme: accent/accentSoft/heroFrom/heroTo 为 #RRGGBB；surface=light|dark 决定整页底色

errors.outcomeRule: tools/call is conservatively unknown; discovery is read_failed

imageConsumers.thirdPartyHttp: current_run_authorized_image_bytes_to_multipart_in_reference_order_no_preview_fallback; a ComfyUI attachment from the same run (uploaded input or upstream output) is read through the configured ComfyUI view route, because it has no run-local archive copy

info.title: Zane Workbench AI API
info.description: AI操作面契约，不是所有旧版设置/连接器接口的全集。工具参数与文档同源；只读/预检不生成，执行可能计费。MCP响应包装与原HTTP对象不同。

servers.description: 以实际工作台后台地址为基址

get.description: 读取全系统流程任务并发配置（固定单例）与 revision、环境默认值、当前 active/queued/preparing 计数。未保存时 revision 为 0、默认取 ZANE_MAX_ACTIVE_RUNS（2，范围1–32）。不启动任务，不接受作用域参数。

200.description: 成功。HTTP直接返回业务对象；MCP包裹为{ok,data,requestId?}。

patch.description: 用当前 revision 更新系统流程任务并发 maxActiveRuns（1–32），SQLite 即时生效。调高放行排队任务，调低不取消已运行任务；已有排队任务可能开始执行。不提交任务、不审批、不发布、不调用模型。409 或回执丢失先 get_task_concurrency 对账，不自动重放。

200.description: 成功。HTTP直接返回业务对象；MCP包裹为{ok,data,requestId?}。

get.description: 只读运行时指标：进程（node/平台/运行秒数/RSS/堆）与运行队列（maxActiveRuns、queued/active/preparing/accepting/ready/subscribers、未完成计数）；diagnostics=1 追加 SQLite PRAGMA quick_check。不含场景内容、运行明细或凭据，不执行变更。

200.description: 成功。HTTP直接返回业务对象；MCP包裹为{ok,data,requestId?}。

get.description: 只读进程内结构化日志窗口（有界环形缓冲，重启清零；容量 ZANE_LOG_BUFFER_ENTRIES）。excludeEvent 可排除前缀（逗号分隔）。游标是 sequence keyset 锚点、追加安全；换筛选复用旧游标 400 INVALID_LOG_CURSOR，更早条目被容量挤出 409 LOG_PAGE_CHANGED 须重读第一页。字段已脱敏、超长值标记 truncated；不含提示词与运行输入全文。细节见手册 §10.2。

200.description: 成功。HTTP直接返回业务对象；MCP包裹为{ok,data,requestId?}。

get.description: 只读运维日志文件尾部；file 只取服务端白名单成员，不接受任意路径（不是文件读取代理）。默认末尾200行（最大2000），可按 level/q 过滤。必须读 complete/scannedWholeFile：complete 才是整份文件，超限只扫描末尾窗口。行已脱敏。细节见手册 §10.2。

200.description: 成功。HTTP直接返回业务对象；MCP包裹为{ok,data,requestId?}。

get.description: 读取运行事件聚合通知的固定单例配置、revision、投递统计与可用平台适配器（formats：id/label/maxChars）。地址含平台 token：只返回 urlMasked 与 hasUrl，明文永不回显。只读，不发送通知、不执行生成。

200.description: 成功。HTTP直接返回业务对象；MCP包裹为{ok,data,requestId?}。

patch.description: 用当前 revision 更新运行事件聚合通知：url 三态（省略=保持、空串=清除、非空=替换）、webhookFormat（discord|slack|feishu|generic）、events（白名单，完整替换）、aggregateSeconds（5–300）、enabled，以及入站转发的 relayEnabled/relayToken（同样三态）。启用要求已有地址且至少 1 个事件；清空地址同时关闭转发。地址明文存本机 SQLite，读接口只回掩码。仅改配置，不发送、不执行；409 或回执丢失先 get_notification_webhook 对账。

200.description: 成功。HTTP直接返回业务对象；MCP包裹为{ok,data,requestId?}。

post.description: 按已保存适配器向该地址真实发送一条固定测试消息。唯一立即出网的配置操作：一次请求、不重试（429/5xx 最多再试一次），失败返回 sent:false 与脱敏摘要而非抛错。不改配置、不调用模型、不计费。

200.description: 成功。HTTP直接返回业务对象；MCP包裹为{ok,data,requestId?}。

post.description: 管理员把一段内容转发到已配置的目标 Webhook（与外部系统的入站转发共用投递与适配器，但用管理员身份而非 relay token）。接受任意形状：纯文本、任意 JSON、表单、Slack/Discord/飞书原生载荷都归一成文本，只有空内容才 400。目标与平台只来自服务端配置，请求体不能指定目标；正文按平台上限截断。同步返回 relayed/status/target/chars/truncated；目标拒绝返回 relayed:false 而非抛错。

200.description: 成功。HTTP直接返回业务对象；MCP包裹为{ok,data,requestId?}。

get.description: 读取指定最终/步骤媒体输出的归档ZIP信息；只核对已归档文件，不生成、不下载远程媒体。仅终态；返回 incomplete/fileCount/revision 与需鉴权 downloadUrl，下载必须用该 revision（内容变化409重读）。清单与媒体用 get_run_outputs/get_step_result。

200.description: 成功。HTTP直接返回业务对象；MCP包裹为{ok,data,requestId?}。

get.description: 读取本地导出根目录（固定单例）与 revision。这是 core.code localExport 写盘与 fileAccess 读文件共用的唯一授权边界：只允许根目录内部，两者各自独立开关。沙箱没有文件系统权限。未配置时分别报 LOCAL_EXPORT_DISABLED / FILE_ACCESS_DISABLED。只读。契约 x-local-export、x-local-file-access。

200.description: 成功。HTTP直接返回业务对象；MCP包裹为{ok,data,requestId?}。

patch.description: 用当前 revision 设置本地导出根目录 root（绝对路径、不能是盘符根；空串关闭该能力）。保存前真实创建并写入探测。该 root 是 localExport 与 fileAccess 的唯一安全边界：任何 target/路径归一化后必须落在其内，否则 LOCAL_EXPORT_OUTSIDE_ROOT / FILE_OUTSIDE_ROOT，符号链接指向根外同样拒绝。仅改配置，不发布、不执行。409 或回执丢失先 get_local_export 对账。

200.description: 成功。HTTP直接返回业务对象；MCP包裹为{ok,data,requestId?}。

get.description: 分页读取「直连模型提供商」注册表与列表 revision；core.llm 步骤 direct=true 时按该提供商的 protocol 直接请求，完全不走 Hermes。密钥以明文存本机 SQLite（产品选定），读接口永不回显明文、只给 credential.apiKeyMasked 与 hasApiKey；baseUrl 允许本机/内网。含保留的默认提供商（providerId direct-llm-default，reservedDefault，不可删除）。默认limit24、最大100；目录变化 409 DIRECT_LLM_PROVIDER_PAGE_CHANGED 重读第一页。契约 x-direct-llm v2，细节见手册 §1.4。

200.description: 成功。HTTP直接返回业务对象；MCP包裹为{ok,data,requestId?}。

post.description: 新建一个直连模型提供商。providerId 由客户端预生成并持久保存：回执丢失用 get_direct_llm_provider 读同一 ID 对账，不换 ID 重建；重复 ID 返回 409 PROVIDER_ALREADY_EXISTS（不是幂等成功）。必填 providerId/name/protocol/baseUrl，且 apiKey 与 apiKeyEnv 至少填一个。apiKey 明文写入本机 SQLite，读接口只回掩码与末4位。enabled=true 需配置齐全，否则400。只改配置，不执行、不计费。

201.description: 成功。HTTP直接返回业务对象；MCP包裹为{ok,data,requestId?}。

get.description: 按稳定 providerId 读取该提供商的配置、revision、origin 与可用模型缓存。origin=saved 时 revision 从 1 起；legacy-singleton/environment 表示来自 1.5.39 单例或环境默认值（revision=0），首次保存会写成新式文档。永不返回密钥明文。不存在返回 404 DIRECT_LLM_PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND。只读，不调用模型。

200.description: 成功。HTTP直接返回业务对象；MCP包裹为{ok,data,requestId?}。

patch.description: 用当前 revision 更新 name/protocol/baseUrl/apiKey/apiKeyEnv/enabled（models 省略=保持、给出=完整替换）；providerId 不可改。apiKey 三态：省略=保持已保存密钥（只改名称或地址不会清空）、空串=清除、非空=替换。首次保存保留的默认提供商会写成新式文档并删除旧单例，避免同一 ID 两个真相。409 或回执丢失先读同一 ID 对账。只改配置，不执行、不计费。

200.description: 成功。HTTP直接返回业务对象；MCP包裹为{ok,data,requestId?}。

delete.description: 用当前 revision 删除一个直连模型提供商记录。保留的默认提供商拒绝删除（400）：改为 update 置 enabled=false，或让步骤显式选择另一个。删除只移除配置记录：不删除历史运行、媒体、素材或已发布快照；引用它的新执行会明确失败。409 或回执丢失先 list_direct_llm_providers 对账。

200.description: 成功。HTTP直接返回业务对象；MCP包裹为{ok,data,requestId?}。

reviewAfterItems.description: 仅 mode=for_each：第 N 项完成后暂停等待人工确认（调度屏障——不派发第 N 项及其后的项，因此确认时恰好完成 N 项，并发不会越过该点）。approve 后复用已完成项继续剩余项且不再在该点暂停；redo 重做截至该点的这一段并再次暂停；N 不小于遍历项数时不会触发并在步骤上记录 warning。与步骤结尾的 review.enabled 独立，可同时配置；确认说明沿用 review.instruction

itemRetries.description: 仅 mode=for_each：单项瞬时上游故障的重试次数（0–3，省略=0=只执行一次，与历史一致）。只重试 408/429/5xx、网络中断、请求超时、上游断流导致的输出解析失败；鉴权/参数/schema/业务4xx/取消不重试。重试会再次调用模型并可能计费

itemRetryDelaySeconds.description: 仅 mode=for_each 且 itemRetries>0：首次重试等待秒数（0–60，默认5，指数退避、上限60）；等待期间取消立即中断

startCondition.description: 通用开始条件：规则不满足时步骤跳过，其输出按null参与下游引用；不新增条件节点。左值/右值引用input或前序step输出，运算符equals/not_equals/greater_than/greater_or_equal/less_than/less_or_equal/contains/not_contains/is_empty/is_not_empty；valueSource=reference时比较两个引用。旧control条件步骤与runCondition仍兼容已发布快照。

onError.description: 单项失败的处理：continue 继续剩余项，只要还有成功项，步骤以 completed_with_errors 结束并继续下游——媒体列表输出只包含成功项，非媒体数组输出中失败项为 null；全部失败或启用 carry 时仍整步失败/停止

maxConcurrencyRef.description: 并发引用：指向本场景已声明的 number 输入（如 input.concurrency），运行时取该值作为本步骤 for_each 的并发；与 maxConcurrency 互斥，仅 mode=for_each 且未启用 carry 时有效。留空表示不限制（取32，再受 ComfyUI 全局并发预算与任务级并发上限约束）；填0、负数、小数或超过32在执行前直接拒绝，不静默回退为串行。省略时按 maxConcurrency 或串行1执行

reviewAfterItems.description: 仅 mode=for_each：第 N 项完成后暂停等待人工确认（调度屏障——不派发第 N 项及其后的项，因此确认时恰好完成 N 项，并发不会越过该点）。approve 后复用已完成项继续剩余项且不再在该点暂停；redo 重做截至该点的这一段并再次暂停；N 不小于遍历项数时不会触发并在步骤上记录 warning。与步骤结尾的 review.enabled 独立，可同时配置；确认说明沿用 review.instruction
